summary: The dashboard demonstrates solid dark-mode styling and layout structure, with only minor truncation and pagination completeness issues.

issues.title: Premature text truncation
issues.description: User role string truncates prematurely with an ellipsis despite available card width.
issues.suggestion: Increase max-width on the metadata line to allow full text display.

issues.title: Incomplete pagination controls
issues.description: Pagination footer provides row counts and page size selector but lacks navigation chevrons.
issues.evidence: Footer displays selection text and 'Rows per page 10' without next/previous buttons.
issues.suggestion: Render page navigation arrow buttons inside DataTablePagination.
